```plato

//==
// # Cloth bound to a mesh
//
// `Cloth3D` stores triangles, because collision and rendering want triangles.
// A cloth built from a `PolygonMesh3D` came from a face table that may hold
// quads or larger faces, and that table is what a caller wants back. Pairing
// the two keeps the original topology alive across the simulation without
// changing `Cloth3D`.

// A cloth together with the polygon face table it was built from. The table is
// never touched by the solver — only positions move — so
// `ToPolygonMesh` (`cloth.library.plato`) rebuilds the source mesh exactly,
// with the simulated positions substituted in.
//
// Faces indexes into the same vertex numbering as `Cloth.Vertices`: vertex i of
// the cloth is position i of the mesh.
type ClothMesh3D
    implements IValue
{
    Cloth: Cloth3D;
    Faces: JaggedArray<VertexIndex>;
}
```
